scientific_integrity.assumptions: Known integer period q>=2, real shift x>0, periodic coefficients with zero mean; arbitrary complex values.
scientific_integrity.limitations: Only positive-real zero counts; no uniform conditioning or extension to nonzero mean or complex zeros.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Positive Mellin integral and strict determinant/Wronskian inequalities; numerical checks are supplemental.

title: Sharp finite Stieltjes-jet recovery of zero-mean periodic Dirichlet series
